items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And see, then we come up and met Mr. Jack Bradley.

ctx.x: And he had a -- he composed a hit for us to do in the show which was "Got to go tap dancing tonight," which we still continue to convey, you see. And, see, he's not well now. And he's in intensive care, and we're trying to keep it going for his sake, and our choreographers' sake. Derby Wilson, he's away.
So, now -- well, so we finished a commitment down there. And see, then we come up and met Mr. Jack Bradley. And so, he wanted us to get into the hot jazz society, which was about musicians.
So, we began to tap dancing when they opened up a jazz museum up here in -- is that -- I think that's 55th Street near the Avenue of Americas.
